name: Withering Link II
description:
Dealing damage heals the unit and summoned minions for half the amount. Redirects 35% of all damage taken directly to living minions. When killing a cursed enemy, summon get 1 stack of SOUL HARVEST, max 2 stacks.

SOUL HARVEST: +15% Max HP, +10% Damage Dealt, and -5% Damage Taken per stack.
